answer: Your records do not list any allergies. The allergy section of your record is empty, so nothing is recorded as an allergy or drug intolerance. That does not fully prove you have no allergies, because a record can be missing information. Please check with your GP or pharmacist, and tell them about any reaction you have had to a medicine, food or other substance, so it can be added to your record.
short: No allergies or intolerances are recorded in her pod. The allergy list is empty, so it may be incomplete and should be confirmed with her doctor or pharmacist.

knowledge.says: An empty allergy list may mean no allergies were ever reported, or that they were not captured, so a clinician should confirm it before relying on it for prescribing.
